body_zh: “你”有两种：对熟人、朋友、孩子说 jij，对陌生人、长辈和在办事处说 u（您）。拿不准时用 u。
很多代词有轻读形式：jij → je，wij → we，zij → ze。口语里轻读形式更常见，意思不变。
zij / ze 既可以是“她”，也可以是“他们”，看后面的动词：zij is（她是），zij zijn（他们是）。
body_en: Dutch has two words for “you”: jij for friends, family and children, u for strangers, older people and officials. When in doubt, use u.
Many pronouns have an unstressed form: jij → je, wij → we, zij → ze. In speech the short forms are more common.
zij / ze means “she” or “they”; the verb tells you which: zij is (she is), zij zijn (they are).
